content.comment_body: I have an idea for detecting errors in communication between networked [product_name] devices, especially when a setup that was working suddenly experiences a broken network cable. Open to further suggestions from others.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is exploring methods to identify communication errors between networked [product_name] devices, particularly when a network cable fails unexpectedly. They hope for reliable notification or indication of such network issues, but currently face uncertainty and limited solutions for effective detection.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for an efficient, potentially automated way to detect communication errors between networked [product_name] devices when a network cable is disconnected or fails.
